newsitem.title: INDIA: One dead, 12 injured in India explosion.
newsitem.headline: One dead, 12 injured in India explosion.

text.p: One person was killed and 12 were injured on Wednesday in an explosion outside a cinema in the Indian capital, police said.
The cause of the explosion in a parking lot next to the cinema was not yet known, a police spokesman said.
A worker at a nearby hotel told Reuters he believed the explosion, at an upmarket suburb in south Delhi, was caused by a gas cylinder.
